# Urbania on Rent Delhi

> Force Urbania van rental in Delhi NCR with driver: 9, 12 and 16 seater luxury Urbania for outstation trips, tours, weddings, airport transfers and corporate travel. Fares from Rs 40/km to Rs 45/km. 611 destination routes from Delhi.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 72908 85949
- Email: rentonurbania@gmail.com
- Address: B-26, Rajeev Nagar, Near Radhey Krishna Mandir, Begumpur, New Delhi - 110086 (Opp. Rohini Sec-22)
